fields.title: 📖 Speak good or remain silent
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or it was transmitted:

> ***“Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The tongue is a gate to reward or burden. Silence is not weakness when the word carries no benefit.

immutable.source: 📝 Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim; Überlieferung von Abū Hurayrah.
